name: Direct Send Compositing
definition: A parallel compositing method that divides the final image into n screen space tiles to avoid exchanging full-size images. Each processor is associated with compositing a tile and sends over all other tiles from the full-size image it rendered.
summary: Direct Send Compositing is a parallel method that combines partial images by dividing the screen into tiles, where each processor composites one tile after a single all-to-all data exchange, differing from hierarchical algorithms by using simpler, one-stage communication.
